localPolicies.scope: existing Map2 Necromancer and King units; no claim all hero skills, other maps or full PvP are finished
localPolicies.ownerLifetime: bind owner world, actor, room, map, battleStats.id (including undefined-to-new-ID transition), heroID, source skin and star; positiveHP and loaded state; stale/expired units unavailable to target selection, demon share/heal, King protection and outgoing missiles before cleanup
localPolicies.pendingCast: capture owner binding; invalid source/CC or >1000ms after native cast point cancels instead of a delayed ghost summon; deadline is local lag policy
localPolicies.cleanup: track actual owned summon rooms; remove old units/projectiles through captured room/map without destroying a same-ID record in a new room; normal life/death/hero/logout cleanup retained
localPolicies.targetSelection: retain a valid remembered row/actor/spawn within existing native guard range, otherwise nearest eligible mob/boss; exclude hidden/dead/safe. Sticky selection is reconstructed, not recovered retail threat ranking
localPolicies.windup: bind target row/actor/spawn, revalidate original target at release, never redirect an already accepted cast to a replacement; native skillStop on invalid target/source-safe/expired deadline; melee still checks original sector/range
localPolicies.persistence: <=250ms retry within castPoint+1000ms deadline; successful kill still uses existing atomic progression. Native skillCast emitted only after successful melee damage or actual missile creation, preventing repeated fire/release animations during failed saves
localPolicies.capacity: full existing64 projectile limit waits50ms within original cast deadline; no fake casting and no instant damage fallback; this retry interval is local
localPolicies.missiles: heroSummon source validity checked before travel; native unit shots limited to mobs/bosses, clipped by current static/building colliders using existing geometry/line checks. No city wall data or generic weapon/pet terrain policy changed
localPolicies.retainedPartialBehaviour: old follow/spacing, attack geometry, damage/resistance and Necromancer permanent-vs-duration interpretation remain reconstructions; native2225 multi-contact breath/retail cadence not restored by star fix; natural AI, global notice and other backlog not declared done
